answer: A sonnet enters karst only by extending the single work chain in karst with as many judged epochs as sonnets already admitted plus one; each epoch after a fixed genesis burns one lantern and must be judged by the prior epoch's attestor, and karst accepts one extension per epoch. The kth sonnet therefore owes k judged epochs, so a thousand sonnets cost 500,500 lantern and 500,500 serialized epochs, the bill attached to each entry in karst. It breaks if lantern is mintable or the chain can fork.
